pages.title: Shredding Unit
pages.text: The Shredding Unit breaks down larger materials into smaller pieces — primary processing for ores, plant fibers, etc.$(br2)Power: 5 $(efu)$(br)Speed: 1 item per 2 seconds$(br)Clearance: 3x3
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
